operators.customDisplayName: List all SP3 files by glob and fallback os.walk under data/astronomy/input/swarm/POD for Swarm-A September 2019 POD data.
Filter SP3 files for Swarm-A from September 2 to 29, 2019. Uses glob pattern for 201909 files and filters by start date extracted from filename (20190902 to 20190929).

Parse all 28 SP3 files (Sep 2-29, 2019) for Swarm-A satellite. Extracts epoch timestamps and ECEF XYZ positions (km) from lines starting with '*' (epoch) and 'PL47' or 'PA' (position). Skips bad/missing values (>1e8). Returns DataFrame with columns: epoch, x_km, y_km, z_km.
